name: efactura-received-001-baseline
statements: CREATE TABLE efactura_received_fetches(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_fetches_environment_valid CHECK(environment IN('test','prod')),cif TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_fetches_cif_digits CHECK(cif ~ '^[0-9]{2,10}$'),window_start TEXT NOT NULL,window_end TEXT NOT NULL,gap_start TEXT NOT NULL,gap_end TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_fetches_state_valid CHECK(state IN('listing','downloading','completed','failed')),pages_listed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CONSTRAINT efactura_received_fetches_pages_listed_nonnegative CHECK(pages_listed>=0),pages_total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CONSTRAINT efactura_received_fetches_pages_total_nonnegative CHECK(pages_total>=0),found INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CONSTRAINT efactura_received_fetches_found_nonnegative CHECK(found>=0),queued INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CONSTRAINT efactura_received_fetches_queued_nonnegative CHECK(queued>=0),downloaded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CONSTRAINT efactura_received_fetches_downloaded_nonnegative CHECK(downloaded>=0),failed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CONSTRAINT efactura_received_fetches_failed_nonnegative CHECK(failed>=0),retries INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CONSTRAINT efactura_received_fetches_retries_nonnegative CHECK(retries>=0),errors JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CONSTRAINT efactura_received_fetches_errors_array CHECK(jsonb_typeof(errors)='array'),next_attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL,created_by TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,CONSTRAINT efactura_received_fetches_window_order CHECK(window_start<window_end),CONSTRAINT efactura_received_fetches_gap_before_window CHECK(gap_start<=gap_end AND gap_end<=window_start))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX efactura_received_fetches_active ON efactura_received_fetches(organization_id,environment) WHERE state IN('listing','downloading')

CREATE TABLE efactura_received_messages(organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_messages_environment_valid CHECK(environment IN('test','prod')),anaf_message_id TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_messages_id_digits CHECK(anaf_message_id ~ '^[0-9]{1,20}$'),upload_index TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_messages_upload_index_digits CHECK(upload_index ~ '^[0-9]{1,20}$'),cif TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_messages_cif_digits CHECK(cif ~ '^[0-9]{1,20}$'),details TEXT NOT NULL,anaf_created TEXT NOT NULL,fetch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES efactura_received_fetches(id),state TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_messages_state_valid CHECK(state IN('listed','stored','download_failed')),attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CONSTRAINT efactura_received_messages_attempts_nonnegative CHECK(attempts>=0),errors JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CONSTRAINT efactura_received_messages_errors_array CHECK(jsonb_typeof(errors)='array'),next_attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL,listed_at TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,environment,anaf_message_id),CONSTRAINT efactura_received_messages_failed_after_attempt CHECK(state<>'download_failed' OR attempts>0))
CREATE INDEX efactura_received_messages_newest ON efactura_received_messages(organization_id,environment,anaf_created DESC,length(anaf_message_id) DESC,anaf_message_id DESC)

CREATE TABLE efactura_received_archives(organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_archives_environment_valid CHECK(environment IN('test','prod')),anaf_message_id TEXT NOT NULL,archive BYTEA NOT NULL,sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_archives_sha256_matches CHECK(sha256=encode(sha256(archive),'hex')),size INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_archives_size_valid CHECK(size>=1 AND size<=11534336 AND size=octet_length(archive)),stored_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,environment,anaf_message_id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,environment,anaf_message_id) REFERENCES efactura_received_messages(organization_id,environment,anaf_message_id))

CREATE TABLE efactura_received_invoices(organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_invoices_environment_valid CHECK(environment IN('test','prod')),anaf_message_id TEXT NOT NULL,document_kind TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_invoices_document_kind_valid CHECK(document_kind IN('invoice','credit_note')),number TEXT NOT NULL,issue_date TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_invoices_issue_date_shape CHECK(issue_date ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),currency TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_invoices_currency_shape CHECK(currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'),supplier_name TEXT NOT NULL,supplier_cif TEXT NOT NULL,total_excluding_tax BIGINT NOT NULL,tax_total BIGINT NOT NULL,payable BIGINT NOT NULL,content JSONB NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_invoices_content_object CHECK(jsonb_typeof(content)='object'),warnings JSONB NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_invoices_warnings_array CHECK(jsonb_typeof(warnings)='array'),read_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,environment,anaf_message_id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,environment,anaf_message_id) REFERENCES efactura_received_archives(organization_id,environment,anaf_message_id))

CREATE TABLE efactura_received_unreadable(organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_unreadable_environment_valid CHECK(environment IN('test','prod')),anaf_message_id TEXT NOT NULL,reason JSONB NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_unreadable_reason_object CHECK(jsonb_typeof(reason)='object'),read_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,environment,anaf_message_id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,environment,anaf_message_id) REFERENCES efactura_received_archives(organization_id,environment,anaf_message_id))

CREATE TABLE efactura_received_coverage(organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_received_coverage_environment_valid CHECK(environment IN('test','prod')),covered_until TEXT NOT NULL,fetch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES efactura_received_fetches(id),updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,environment))
CREATE TRIGGER efactura_received_archives_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON efactura_received_archives FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION qwbe_abort('received e-Factura archives are immutable')
CREATE TRIGGER efactura_received_archives_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON efactura_received_archives FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION qwbe_abort('received e-Factura archives are immutable')
